environment.host_process: A standalone MinGW C executable; NXStudio.exe was never started.
environment.runtime_libraries: Wine built-in Windows and Microsoft C/C++ runtime DLL implementations; the application directory was passed only as the explicit PixelShiftCombine.dll path.
environment.prm_bin_placement: Copied beside the probe EXE for successful output tests. Its necessity has not yet been established.

inputs.source: A normal Z8 lossless 14-bit NEF, not a pixel-shift capture.
inputs.sequence: The same synthetic copy is supplied four times. All sparse-repair selection fields remain zero. This is an invalid physical capture sequence intentionally used to isolate the ABI and sampling equations.

cases.name: invalid_count
cases.observed: DLL loads and returns false without a progress callback.

cases.name: cancel_before_read
cases.observed: Progress callback receives (1,1,5); returning true causes false return without output.

cases.name: normal_single_frame_repeated
cases.observed: The unchanged normal NEF is rejected after progress 5.

cases.name: enabled_marker_repeated
cases.observed: Progress 5,10,20,30,50,60,70,80,95,100; true return and a readable NEFX.

cases.name: output_parent_missing
cases.observed: Progress through 80 then write-error callback code 1; callback returns true and the DLL returns false. No unbounded retry.

numerical_check.comparison: LibRaw-decoded vendor output versus recovered integer sampling, green averaging, and final crop applied to the LibRaw-decoded source.
limitations: Repeated frames cannot distinguish a permutation of otherwise identical input arrays.
Zero sparse-repair fields do not exercise the low-ISO correction branches.
Only four-input, one-output mode is numerically checked here.

conclusions: A standalone process can load and call this DLL without starting NX Studio.
The recovered Microsoft x64 ABI is operational for short inline Software strings and ASCII file paths.
The input parser requires a nonzero mode marker, but this probe shows it does not reject four identical marker-enabled files as an invalid physical sequence.
The four-frame numerical sampling equations match this synthetic repeated-frame output exactly.

late_cancellation_probe.input_kind: Four distinct synthetic packed-14 files; one output.
late_cancellation_probe.static_correlation: The writer closes the destination before progress95; cancellation then returns false without removing it. The helper ignores the progress100 return.
late_cancellation_probe.channel_note: LibRaw stores this RGB data in its four-channel backing array; the TIFF has three samples per pixel.
late_cancellation_probe.native_design_implication: A false vendor return does not imply no output. A native transactional writer needs an explicit commit point and cancellation cleanup policy.
late_cancellation_probe.limit: These cases check callback cancellation, not process termination or partial disk writes.

multioutput_cancellation_probe.input_kind: Eight distinct synthetic packed-14 files; two requested outputs.
multioutput_cancellation_probe.harness_policy: Latch cancellation after the first callback reaches the threshold; all later callbacks return true even when percentage resets for another output.
multioutput_cancellation_probe.observed: The first output reaches100 and remains readable. Processing calls progress(total2,index2,percent5), then returns false; the second output does not exist. Previously completed outputs are not rolled back.

not_proven: A Linux-native implementation or a redistributable vendor backend
Full ABI ownership and Unicode-path behavior
All mode, ISO, sparse-repair, radial-correction, and failure branches
Lightroom Classic compatibility or color fidelity
